_doc: The names rule sets share for what a part mounts by and what it does, so one piece of code can read any of them: a motor, a bearing, a driver, a screw. A set with "part" uses these names directly. An older set keeps its own names and says which is which in "interface". "checks" says what must hold between a part's figures (a head wider than its clearance hole). A field marked "list" holds a list. A thread's older names are its vocabulary: clearance is the normal clearance hole, head and head_height the socket cap head, nut_flats and nut_height the hexagon nut. Read by cad rules check and cad rules draw.

type.says: what sort of motor, or of bearing

body_shape.says: the body's outline, seen from the mounting face

body_width.says: a square frame's side, a box's long side, or a pulley's overall width along its axis

body_top.says: what stands above the mounting face, beside the shaft

body_corner.says: how far each corner of a square frame is cut back

boss_diameter.says: the pilot boss round the shaft

boss_height.says: how far the boss stands proud of the mounting face

boss_offset.says: the shaft's distance from the body's centre, where it isn't central

shaft_length.says: from the mounting face to the shaft's tip

shaft_flat_across.says: across the shaft at its flat, or across two flats

shaft_flat_length.says: the flat's length, back from the tip

horn_screw.says: the thread that holds a servo's horn

mount_pattern.says: four holes on a square, or two

mount_hole_depth.says: the thread's depth in the part

mount_ear_radius.says: the radius of an ear round its hole

mount_tab_length.says: a servo's tabs, end to end

cable_width.says: room for the wires, across the part

cable_reach.says: the wire housing's far side, from the body's centre

screw_clearance.says: a clearance hole for the screw

rated_voltage.says: the voltage its figures are given at

rated_current.says: amps per phase, or the most it works at

pull_in_torque.says: what a geared stepper starts against

friction_torque.says: friction in a built-in gearbox, at the output

torque_limit.says: the most its gearbox should see

no_load_speed.says: free running at the rated voltage

kv.says: a brushless motor's speed per volt

temperature_rise.says: the case above the room, at rated current

radial_load.says: the most sideways load on the shaft

bore.says: a bearing's bore: the shaft fits here

outer_diameter.says: a bearing's outside diameter: the housing fits here

width.says: a bearing's width along its axis; a thrust bearing's height

chamfer.says: the corner radius of a bearing's rings, the most a shaft or housing fillet may be

static_rating.says: a bearing's basic static load rating (radial, or axial for a thrust bearing)

dynamic_rating.says: a bearing's basic dynamic load rating (radial, or axial for a thrust bearing)

radial_play.says: a radial bearing's internal clearance class: CN is normal

flange_diameter.says: a flanged bearing's flange, or a lead-screw nut's

flange_width.says: how thick a flanged bearing's or nut's flange is

shaft_washer_diameter.says: the outside of a thrust bearing's shaft washer

housing_washer_bore.says: the bore of a thrust bearing's housing washer: the shaft must clear it

actuation_force.says: the force to operate a switch

rating_mark.says: the rating marked on a switch's case

resolution.says: an encoder's resolution over a turn

air_gap_min.says: the least gap between an encoder's magnet and chip

air_gap_max.says: the most gap between an encoder's magnet and chip

magnet_field_min.says: the least field across an encoder's chip

magnet_field_max.says: the most field across an encoder's chip

magnet_thickness.says: an encoder's disc magnet, along its axis

magnet_polarity.says: how the magnet is magnetised: diametric is across the round face

supply_voltage_min.says: the least supply a board works from

supply_voltage_max.says: the most supply a board works from

pin_pitch.says: pin spacing along a header row

row_spacing.says: between a board's two header rows

pinout.says: what each pin is, in order

logic_voltage_min.says: a driver's least logic level or supply

logic_voltage_max.says: a driver's most logic level or supply

current_bare.says: a driver's continuous current per coil with no heat sink or moving air

current_cooled.says: a driver's most current per coil with cooling

current_peak.says: a driver's peak current per coil

sense_resistor.says: the resistor a driver measures coil current through

vref_formula.says: how the voltage on a driver's trimmer sets its current

vref_gain.says: the current limit per volt of Vref: A = Vref * gain (RMS for a TMC2209, the peak limit otherwise)

microsteps.says: the step divisions a driver offers

max_microsteps.says: a driver's finest division of a full step

thermal_shutdown.says: the temperature a driver's chip stops at

uart_note.says: how a driver's UART is wired

diameter.says: a lead screw's or smooth rod's outside diameter

lead.says: a lead screw's travel in one turn (or the screw a nut fits)

pitch.says: thread pitch, or a belt's or pulley's tooth pitch

thread.says: a thread as it is written: M3, 6-32 UNC, Tr8x8(P2)

pitch_diameter.says: a thread's or a pulley's pitch diameter

helix_angle.says: a lead screw's lead angle at the pitch diameter

friction_coefficient.says: the thread friction assumed for a lead screw's efficiency

efficiency_note.says: how a lead screw's efficiency and back-driving are worked out, and how far to trust them

length.says: a nut, linear bearing or coupler end to end

flange_offset.says: from a nut's short end to its flange

hole_circle.says: the circle a part's mounting holes sit on

material.says: what the part is made of

tolerance.says: a rod's diameter tolerance, as the source gives it

hardness.says: a rod's surface hardness, as the source gives it

straightness.says: a rod's straightness, as the source gives it

style.says: what sort of coupler, and how it grips

pitch_line_offset.says: a belt's pitch line beyond the pulley's teeth, each side

stiffness.says: the tension that stretches a belt by unit strain, for its width: stretch = tension * length / stiffness

stiffness_per_width.says: a belt's stiffness per mm of its width

min_static_tension.says: a belt's least static tension per span

min_inside_idler_grooves.says: the smallest toothed idler inside a belt

min_backside_idler_diameter.says: the smallest idler on a belt's back

min_flat_idler_diameter.says: the smallest smooth idler running on a belt's teeth

teeth.says: a pulley's or idler's tooth count

tooth_diameter.says: a pulley's diameter across the teeth

belt_width.says: the belt a pulley or idler takes

thread_form.says: a fixing thread's family: ISO metric, unified inch, or a thread-forming screw for plastic

pitch_fine.says: the pitch of the thread's common fine partner, where one is common

tap_drill.says: the drill for tapping the coarse thread in metal

clearance_close.says: a clearance hole for the screw, close fit

clearance.says: a clearance hole for the screw, normal (medium) fit: the one to use unless there is a reason

clearance_loose.says: a clearance hole for the screw, loose fit

head.says: a socket head cap screw's head diameter, at most

head_height.says: a socket head cap screw's head height, at most

head_key.says: the hex key a socket head cap screw takes

button_head.says: a button head socket screw's head diameter, at most

button_head_height.says: a button head socket screw's head height, at most

button_key.says: the hex key a button head socket screw takes

countersunk_head.says: a countersunk socket screw's head diameter where the cone meets a sharp edge: a seat this wide at the surface takes the head flush

countersunk_head_height.says: a countersunk socket screw's head height, at most

countersunk_angle.says: the cone of a countersunk head, across the whole of it

countersunk_key.says: the hex key a countersunk socket screw takes

hex_head_flats.says: a hexagon head screw's width across flats: its spanner

hex_head_height.says: a hexagon head screw's head height

pan_head.says: a pan head screw's head diameter, at most

pan_head_height.says: a pan head screw's head height, at most

pan_head_drive.says: the driver a pan head screw takes: T10, PZ1

nut_flats.says: a hexagon nut's width across flats

nut_height.says: a hexagon nut's height, at most

square_nut_flats.says: a thin square nut's width across flats

square_nut_height.says: a thin square nut's height, at most

lock_nut_flats.says: a nylon-insert lock nut's width across flats

lock_nut_height.says: a nylon-insert lock nut's height, at most

set_screw_key.says: the hex key a socket set screw takes

set_screw_point.says: the diameter of a flat point set screw's end, at most

lengths.says: the lengths the socket head cap screw is sold in, shortest first (a countersunk screw's length includes its head)

property_class.says: the steel property class its strength figure is for: 8.8

proof_stress.says: the stress a steel screw of that class holds with no permanent set

stainless_class.says: the stainless grade and class its second strength figure is for: A2-70

stainless_proof_stress.says: the 0.2 % proof stress of a stainless screw of that grade

insert_diameter.says: a heat-set insert's outside diameter, over its knurls

insert_hole.says: the printed hole a heat-set insert melts into, as drawn: no hole compensation

insert_depth.says: the least depth of a blind hole for a heat-set insert

insert_taper.says: the taper of a heat-set insert's hole, across the whole of it, where its maker asks for one

insert_wall.says: the least plastic round a heat-set insert's hole

pilot.says: a starting hole for the screw to form its own thread in printed plastic, as drawn, before a printer's measured figure (x1c.pilot_m3) replaces it

pilot_depth.says: the least depth of thread a screw needs in plastic

pilot_boss.says: the least outside diameter of a boss round a pilot hole

thread.says: a tap drill is under the thread, and the clearance holes over it in order: close, normal, loose
a tap drill is about the major diameter less the pitch
a fine pitch is finer than the coarse one
a pilot in plastic is wider than a tap drill and tighter than the closest clearance hole
a pilot is close to the thread it is formed by (drawn for printing, it can pass a small thread's own diameter)
a pilot is wider than the root of the thread formed in it
a thread's root is inside its crest
a key fits inside its head
a cap head is wider than the loosest clearance hole, or it pulls through
a key fits inside its head
a button head is wider than the loosest clearance hole
a key fits inside its head
a countersunk head is wider than the loosest clearance hole
a hexagon head is wider than the loosest clearance hole
a pan head is wider than the loosest clearance hole
a nut is wider than its thread
a nut is wider than its thread
a lock nut is taller than a plain one, by its nylon ring
a washer's hole passes the thread, and its rim stands outside it
a washer covers the loosest clearance hole
a set screw's key fits inside its thread
an insert's hole is wider than its thread and narrower than its knurls, which the plastic flows round
a blind hole is deeper than its insert
the stainless figure is the lower of the two
